description: High-level health overview of the glemmen cluster: active alerts, node readiness and resource usage, Longhorn and SeaweedFS volume health, and application/service workload and certificate status.

panels.description: Firing critical and warning alerts plus all pending alerts. The table below lists every active alert, including info and none severity.
panels.title: Alerts

panels.description: Share of Kubernetes nodes reporting the Ready condition.
panels.title: Nodes ready

panels.description: Longhorn volume robustness across all volumes. Healthy means all replicas are available; degraded means a replica is missing; faulted means the volume is unavailable.
panels.title: Longhorn volumes

panels.description: Regular SeaweedFS volume health. Healthy = not under-replicated and writable; degraded = under-replicated; faulty = read-only. EC shards are shown separately in the collection table.

targets.expr: clamp_min((sum(SeaweedFS_volumeServer_volumes{type="volume"}) or vector(0)) - (sum(SeaweedFS_master_under_replicated_volumes) or vector(0)) - (sum(max by (collection, pod) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_read_only_volumes)) or vector(0)), 0)

panels.title: SeaweedFS volumes

panels.description: Share of desired Deployment, StatefulSet and DaemonSet replicas that are ready.
panels.title: Workloads ready

panels.description: cert-manager Certificates that expire within the next 21 days.
panels.title: Certificates expiring

panels.description: Active alerts grouped by name, severity, namespace and state. Firing alerts are also routed to https://alerts.glem.men.
panels.title: Active alerts

panels.description: Number of firing alerts by severity over the selected time range.
panels.title: Firing alerts over time

panels.description: Node readiness, role, current CPU/memory/system-disk usage, uptime and pod count. Disk usage is the /var filesystem.
panels.title: Node status

panels.description: Every Longhorn volume with its robustness state and capacity. Sorted so degraded and faulted volumes appear first; healthy volumes are shown in green.
panels.title: Longhorn volume status

panels.description: Per SeaweedFS collection: status, regular volumes, EC shards, under-replicated volumes, read-only volumes and stored data. Status is Faulty for read-only volumes and Degraded for under-replicated volumes.

targets.expr: ((sum by (collection) (max by (collection, pod) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_read_only_volumes{collection!=""})) > 0) * 0 + 2) or ((sum by (collection) (SeaweedFS_master_under_replicated_volumes{collection!=""}) > 0) * 0 + 1) or ((sum by (collection) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_volumes{collection!=""}) >= 0) * 0)

panels.title: SeaweedFS volume status by collection

panels.description: Per SeaweedFS volume server: regular volumes, EC shards, read-only volumes, disk errors, stored data and the age of the last scrub.
panels.title: SeaweedFS volume servers

panels.description: Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets per namespace: how many are fully ready versus the total. Rows with not-ready workloads are highlighted.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace) ((kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready >= bool kube_deployment_spec_replicas) or (kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready >= bool kube_statefulset_replicas) or (kube_daemonset_status_number_ready >= bool kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled))

panels.title: Workloads by namespace

panels.description: cert-manager Certificates with readiness and time until expiry. Expiring certificates turn orange within 14 days and red within 7 days.
panels.title: Certificates
